subject.title: Feature: channels.slack.ignoreSubtypes config key to suppress message_changed / message_deleted events

question: Should OpenClaw add a public Slack `ignoreSubtypes` config key for opt-in suppression of `message_changed` and `message_deleted` before system-event enqueue?
rationale: The source-level problem is real, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config keys and prior broad-ignore attempts were intentionally not merged.

options.title: Add opt-in Slack config
options.body: Approve a narrow `ignoreSubtypes` list that defaults to current behavior and is documented/tested at the Slack plugin boundary.

options.title: Keep current system events
options.body: Decline the new config surface and keep edit/delete events as intentional session-scoped system context.

options.title: Change default subtype policy
options.body: Revisit Slack edit/delete defaults without a new key, which would need stronger upgrade and Assistant DM proof before implementation.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in Slack config
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow `ignoreSubtypes` list that defaults to current behavior and is documented/tested at the Slack plugin boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current source/history signal and the relevant config-surface policy is a product decision.
